[[File:PrimusGoluud-Timeline12.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]], a [[Red supergiant/Legends|red supergiant]]]]
A '''supergiant''' was a type of [[Star/Legends|star]]. Three of the stars in the [[Kuna constellation]]&mdash;[[Kuna's Heart]], [[Kuna's Gullet]], and [[Kuna's Scale]]&mdash;were supergiants.<ref name="gamer9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>
